collection.description: A fisher says a Canary Flashfish swims differently, and a jeweler wants its fin as a model for metalwork.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A fisher claims that a Canary Flashfish swims differently from its close relatives. A jeweler wants to use its unusual fin as a model for decorative metalwork.

choices.label: Study its movement in the wild
Sketch the fin for the jeweler
Capture a live fish to preserve it

a.name: Answer A
a.text: Repeated observations yield a careful description, although currents make the measurements uncertain.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The jeweler makes a beautiful motif, but a visiting researcher points out a mistaken ray count.

c__fx.name: Answer C
c__fx.text: The fin structure is clearer; the villager records that this specimen was found dead rather than collected alive.

text_only.reason: an animal found dead; no villager dies

d__fx.name: Answer D
d__fx.text: A complete specimen improves comparison but kills the animal; if the population is rare, the choice prompts restrictions on future collecting.
